blurb: A light pickup with a machine gun on the back: a driver, a gunner who fires all round and three passengers with their own weapons

notes.half: The model is 2.24 m wide, 1.94 m tall and 4.4 m long.
notes.seats: Measured on the model: the cab (roof 1.94 m, floor 0.25 m) has no seats of its own, so the two cab riders sit on cushions 0.7 m up, just ahead of its back wall; the bed floor is about 1.0 m up and its side rails 1.3 m. The roof gunner stands in the bed at the gun; two more ride sitting on the side rails behind it, legs over the side.
notes.vehicle: Its own wheels (the model's wheel meshes, measured on it) on stiffer springs than the buggy's: a pickup.
